title: SKLZ Quickster 4-in-1 Football Trainer
amazon_match_notes: Verified exact match: ASIN B00CMSXIJI identifies the SKLZ Quickster 4-in-1 football trainer, model 0778.

comparisons.notes: Manufacturer-direct US offer, SKU 0778. Live page was available to add to cart at $239.99. The page advertised 30% off with code XTRA30, yielding $167.99 before tax; comparison uses the verified list price from the market_price field.

writeup: Woot has a new SKLZ Quickster 4-in-1 football trainer for $37.99. This is model 0778, a portable net for practicing passing, punting, kicking, and snapping, and it matches ASIN B00CMSXIJI. SKLZ's own US product page lists the same trainer in stock for $239.99 and it was available to add to cart. That is about 84 percent below SKLZ and saves roughly $202. Woot showed only 1 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
